help.title: Roles and permissions
help.roles.title: Who can do what
help.area.schedule: Working hours, days off, extra hours
help.area.website: Booking form key for your website
help.eachRole.title: What each role is for
help.role.owner: The account created when the clinic signed up. Full access to everything, including staff and the booking form keys. Only the owner can edit their own account.
help.role.admin: Runs the clinic day to day: dentists, services, offices, working hours, keys and staff. Can do everything the owner can, except edit the owner’s account.
help.role.registrar: The front desk. Works with visits and clients all day: books, moves, confirms and cancels them, and marks who arrived. Sees dentists, services, hours and settings, but does not change them.
help.note.ownerProtected: The owner’s account can be edited only by the owner, and the owner’s role cannot be changed or switched off.
help.note.selfRole: Nobody can change their own role or disable their own account — ask another manager.
help.note.dentists: A dentist is not a staff account: dentists do not sign in to the panel and work in Telegram instead.
help.note.operator: The DentBook platform operator sees the list of clinics and can suspend a clinic, but has no access to your clients or visits.
help.how.title: How the platform works
help.how.setup.title: Setting up, in order
help.how.setup.text: Offices first, then services with their duration and the buffer after them, then dentists — for each one the services they provide, their place in the priority order and their working hours. Once that is in place, create a key on the Website page and put the booking form on your site.
help.how.booking.title: How a booking from your website happens
help.how.booking.text: The client picks a service and a time on your website and confirms their phone with a code from an SMS. The dentist is chosen automatically: the first in the priority order among those free at that time; if several are equal, the one with fewer visits that day. The visit appears in the journal straight away.
help.how.booking.confirm: With “Online bookings need confirmation” on in Settings, the visit waits for the clinic to confirm it, and the client is told so.
help.how.availability.title: How free time is calculated
help.how.availability.text: Free time is never stored. It is worked out for every request from the dentist’s working hours, their days off and extra hours, and the visits already booked together with the buffer after each one. A time is offered only if the whole visit and its buffer fit.
help.how.availability.settings: Settings shape it too: the step of the time grid, the shortest notice a client may book at, and how far ahead the form shows.
help.how.journal.title: Journal and confirmations
help.how.journal.text: The day view puts the dentists of one office side by side, the week view shows one dentist. Drag a visit to move it — an overlap is refused by the database. Confirm or cancel a visit and mark whether the client arrived; the client gets an SMS about a move or a cancellation.
help.how.telegram.title: Dentists in Telegram
help.how.telegram.text: On the Dentists page create a connection link for a dentist. In Telegram they get an alert for every new visit, see their schedule, can close time and book their own clients. A dentist cannot close time that already has a visit — the front desk moves it first.
help.how.sms.title: Reminders and messages
help.how.sms.text: The client gets an SMS when the visit is confirmed, then reminders a day and two hours before it. Cancel or move the visit and the reminders follow. Nothing is sent between 21:00 and 08:00 in the office’s time zone.
